thread:
Anya (partnerships): Quick sync — proposing a lightweight 'choreography' for SI co-sells so we don't have parallel nudges to customers. Outline: claim window, announcement owner, marketplace listing lead.
Mike S (solutions): love the word choreography :) is claim window fixed or dynamic by deal size?
Anya (partnerships): default 48h for inbound qualified leads, extendable to 5 business days for named accounts. we should surface exceptions in the CRM.
Dave E (sales): +1 on 48h. needs to be enforced or reps start 'poaching'. can handshake-bot write a claim record when SI mentions the account?
handshake-bot: auto-claim trigger: message contains "si-claim:" + account domain -> creates provisional claim record. needs partner id mapping.
Rachel P (eng): technical ask: marketplace listing sync can be automated for joint announcements via webhook. we'll need partner marketplace IDs and a "go-live" timestamp field.
Anya (partnerships): ok Rachel — we'll map partner IDs in the intake form. Mike/Dave, who owns the announcement PR/comms? we want single visible owner.
Mike S (solutions): solutions will draft the joint announcement, but legal + SI approvals in parallel. we should set a 10-business-day lead for co-sell public posts.
Dave E (sales): For account mapping, propose a short matching rule: if company name exact OR top-level domain matches + >1000 employee, flag as named and require AE sign-off.
Anya (partnerships): Agree. I'll add those rules to the intake doc and share a one-pager. Also suggest a soft-fallthrough: if no claim after 48h, partner gets first outreach but we alert the AE.
Rachel P (eng): I'll add a webhook for claim status changes -> sales notifications channel. ETA end of week.
Anya (partnerships): Great — next steps: I'll publish the one-pager, Mike please start a trial on 2 live leads, Rachel to hook webhook, handshake-bot to enable provisional claim creation.
Mike S (solutions): will do, starting today. thanks!
Dave E (sales): cheers.
handshake-bot: note: provisional claim logs will include message link and timestamp. use /claim-review to finalize.
Anya (partnerships): thanks team — will post intake doc shortly and tag everyone for feedback :thumbsup:
